#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Private, offline compatibility evidence; no device or publication operations.

Reads the exact pinned source and two existing app-only packages. All generated
flash images are temporary synthetic buffers, never device captures or outputs.
No network fetch, firmware build, default package change, or bootloader delivery.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TREE = "025b3e64f43634ade0928af7b2315336cc391e0f"
PACKAGES = {
    "pro": ("x0x-smk37.fwsc", "c0ce49794cb5692c4c9ab65552a8193e445945f06a5488a24b769b9e9172484f"),
    "elite": ("x0x-smk37-elite.fwsc", "67dcf8be40279e8b1e44224b3c1c9b76f1b425837b7ce634ae0ecd41d5c3f172"),
}
CHECKS = []

def checked(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)

def blob_hash(raw):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()

def import_file(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def pass_check(label):
    CHECKS.append(label)
    print("PASS " + label, flush=True)

def expected_error(call, label):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError:
        pass_check(label)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("expected refusal: " + label)

def valid_config():
    # Synthetic prefix and minimal required TLVs; not a unit configuration.
    data = bytearray(34)
    for name, value in (("OSC", b"OSC0"), ("OSC_FREQ", struct.pack("<I", 24000000)),
                        ("SYS_CLK", struct.pack("<I", 360000000)),
                        ("HSB_DIV", struct.pack("<I", 1)), ("LSB_DIV", struct.pack("<I", 2))):
        data += bytes([len(value)]) + name.encode() + b"\0" + value
    return bytes(data + b"\0")

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--repo", required=True, type=Path, help="Clean exact-tree firmware checkout; read only")
    ap.add_argument("--packages", required=True, type=Path, help="Existing smk37-pad-diag-evidence directory")
    ap.add_argument("--upstream", type=Path, default=HERE / ".inputs/upstream")
    ap.add_argument("--sanitize", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, help="Nonsecret JSON output; no firmware bytes")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not __debug__:
        raise SystemExit("Python optimization is forbidden for this evidence runner")
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    repo, upstream = args.repo.resolve(), args.upstream.resolve()
    git = lambda *a: subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), *a], text=True).strip()
    checked(git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}") == TREE, "wrong firmware source tree")
    checked(not git("status", "--porcelain"), "firmware checkout is not clean")
    manifest = json.loads((HERE / "upstream-manifest.json").read_text())
    for path, pin in manifest["files"].items():
        checked(blob_hash((upstream / path).read_bytes()) == pin["git_blob"], "upstream bytes differ: " + path)
    pass_check("exact firmware tree and upstream source blob pins")
    # These modules contain pure package/head helpers. No backend is instantiated.
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "tools"))
    import add_ctl
    import fm1pkg_make as pm
    import fm1_install
    import lz4blk
    bank = import_file("mboot_bankcb_offline", upstream / "tools/bankcb.py")
    source_hashes = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                     for p in (HERE / "run_offline.py", HERE / "compat_core_check.c", HERE / "upstream-manifest.json")}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mboot-offline-") as temp:
        work = Path(temp)
        binary = work / "compat-core-check"
        command = ["cc", "-std=c11", "-O1", "-g", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                   "-I" + str(upstream / "include"), str(HERE / "compat_core_check.c"),
                   str(upstream / "src/core.c"), str(upstream / "src/contract.c"), "-o", str(binary)]
        if args.sanitize:
            command[1:1] = ["-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer"]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        native_env = dict(os.environ)
        if args.sanitize:
            # This executor uses ptrace; LSan cannot attach. ASan/UBSan remain on.
            # This is not a leak-check PASS and is explicitly recorded below.
            native_env["ASAN_OPTIONS"] = "detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1"
            native_env["UBSAN_OPTIONS"] = "halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1"
        def native(*items):
            subprocess.run([str(binary), *map(str, items)], check=True, env=native_env)
        def put(name, data):
            path = work / name; path.write_bytes(data); return path
        native("synthetic")
        pass_check("native synthetic calibration preservation and ABI suite")
        good_cfg = valid_config()
        native("config", put("valid-config", good_cfg), 1)
        native("config", put("truncated-config", good_cfg[:-5]), 0)
        pass_check("required configuration TLVs accepted; truncation refused")
        # A synthetic tagged container, not executable firmware or a release.
        payload = bytearray(240)
        payload[0x40:0x48] = b"AC79BLID"
        payload[0x48:0x50] = b"smk37\0\0\0"
        payload[0x50:0x60] = b"OFFLINE-ONLY\0\0\0\0"
        container = bank.pack(bytes(payload), "smk37")
        container_path = put("synthetic-boot-container", container)
        expected_error(lambda: bank.validate(container, "fm1"), "wrong-board synthetic container refused")
        bad = bytearray(container); bad[-1] ^= 1
        expected_error(lambda: bank.validate(bad, "smk37"), "damaged synthetic container CRC refused")
        for model, (filename, digest) in PACKAGES.items():
            raw = (args.packages / ("official-app-only-" + model) / filename).read_bytes()
            checked(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == digest, "wrong package bytes: " + model)
            product, logical = add_ctl.logical_of(raw)
            checked(product == "SMK-37 " + model.capitalize() + "_900", "wrong model identity")
            state = add_ctl._open(logical)
            full = bytearray(b"\xff" * 0x100000)
            full[:len(state["flash"])] = state["flash"]
            key = state["key"]
            native("app", put(model + "-app", full), key, 1)
            corrupted = bytearray(full); corrupted[0x4120 + 64] ^= 1
            native("app", put(model + "-bad-crc", corrupted), key, 2)
            corrupted = bytearray(full); corrupted[0x4000] ^= 1
            native("app", put(model + "-bad-header", corrupted), key, 0)
            native("app", work / (model + "-app"), key ^ 1, 0)
            pass_check(model + ": actual app parses; bad CRC/header/key refused")
            isd = add_ctl._dec(full[64:96]); address, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", isd, 4)
            native("config", put(model + "-package-config", full[address:address+size]), 0)
            pass_check(model + ": generated package config is not a valid m-bootloader boot config")
            # Prove the unmodified local head guard still refuses an altered head.
            ref = put(model + "-same-head", full[:0x4000])
            checked(fm1_install.head_compare(logical, ref)[0], "matching head refused")
            changed_head = bytearray(full[:0x4000]); changed_head[0xa0] ^= 1
            ref = put(model + "-different-head", changed_head)
            capture = io.StringIO()
            code = fm1_install.head_guard(SimpleNamespace(package=str(args.packages / ("official-app-only-" + model) / filename),
                                                        force=False, head_ref=str(ref)), out=capture, env={})
            checked(code == 11 and "REFUSED" in capture.getvalue(), "changed head was not refused")
            pass_check(model + ": unchanged installer head guard accepts same/refuses different head")
            # A generated SDK package head is not a substitute for a unit head.
            expected_error(lambda: bank.install(bytes(full), container), model + ": synthetic SDK boot allocation rejected by upstream transform")
            native("head", work / (model + "-app"), container_path, work / (model + "-app"), 0)
            # Build a valid synthetic old head, preserving all non-boot allocations.
            synthetic = bytearray(full)
            synthetic[64:96] = bank.enc(pm.entry(pm.crc16(good_cfg), 0x38d0, len(good_cfg), 2, 0x80, 0, "isd_config.ini"))
            synthetic[0x38d0:0x38d0+len(good_cfg)] = good_cfg
            synthetic[32:64] = bank.enc(pm.entry(0xffff, 0xa0, 0x3830, 0, 0, 0, "uboot.boot"))
            after = bank.install(bytes(synthetic), container)
            checked(after[:32] == synthetic[:32] and after[64:0xa0] == synthetic[64:0xa0]
                    and after[0x38d0:] == synthetic[0x38d0:], "synthetic transform changed non-boot bytes")
            checked(bank.extract(after) == container, "synthetic boot transform did not round-trip")
            native("head", put(model + "-synthetic-head", synthetic), container_path,
                   put(model + "-expected-head", after), 1)
            unsafe = bytearray(synthetic)
            unsafe[64:96] = bank.enc(pm.entry(pm.crc16(good_cfg), 0x100, len(good_cfg), 2, 0x80, 0, "isd_config.ini"))
            unsafe_path = put(model + "-overlap-head", unsafe)
            native("head", unsafe_path, container_path, unsafe_path, 0)
            unsafe = bytearray(synthetic); unsafe[64] ^= 1
            unsafe_path = put(model + "-corrupt-head-record", unsafe)
            native("head", unsafe_path, container_path, unsafe_path, 0)
            pass_check(model + ": synthetic boot transform preserves config, app, data, calibration and key/MAC allocations")
            # Stage the exact existing Felucca OTA as ota_stage() does: outer wrapper
            # is replaced, compressed body copied unchanged; never execute the bytes.
            entries = [add_ctl._dec(state["lst"][i:i+80]) for i in range(0, len(state["lst"]), 80)]
            ota_entry = next(e for e in entries if struct.unpack_from("<H", e)[0] == 100)
            off, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", ota_entry, 8); ota = bytes(logical[off:off+size])
            checked(len(ota) == 7339, "unexpected OTA fixture size")
            image = bytearray(); pos = 64
            while pos < len(ota):
                compressed, expanded = struct.unpack_from("<II", ota, pos); pos += 8
                block = lz4blk.decompress(ota[pos:pos+compressed])
                checked(len(block) == expanded, "fixture decompression length")
                image += block; pos += compressed
            checked(len(image) == 8420, "unexpected decoded OTA size")
            full[0xbb000:0xbb000+32] = pm.entry(0xffff, 0xbb000, len(ota), 0x41, 0xff, 0xffff, "LOADER.BIN")
            full[0xbb020:0xbb000+len(ota)] = ota[32:]
            request = bytearray(80)
            struct.pack_into("<HHH", request, 2, 0x5a0d, 0x5a01, 0x5441)
            struct.pack_into("<I", request, 72, 0xbb000)
            struct.pack_into("<H", request, 0, pm.crc16(request[2:]))
            full[0xbff00:0xbff50] = request
            request_path = put(model + "-request", request)
            image_path = put(model + "-decoded-ota", image)
            native("updater", put(model + "-staged", full), request_path, image_path, 1)
            broken = bytearray(full); broken[0xbb000] ^= 1
            native("updater", put(model + "-bad-outer", broken), request_path, image_path, 0)
            broken = bytearray(full)
            struct.pack_into("<I", broken, 0xbb028, 0x01c0a802)
            struct.pack_into("<H", broken, 0xbb020, pm.crc16(broken[0xbb022:0xbb040]))
            native("updater", put(model + "-bad-load", broken), request_path, image_path, 0)
            broken = bytearray(full)
            struct.pack_into("<I", broken, 0xbb024, 0x5b1d)
            struct.pack_into("<H", broken, 0xbb020, pm.crc16(broken[0xbb022:0xbb040]))
            native("updater", put(model + "-oversize", broken), request_path, image_path, 0)
            bad_request = bytearray(request); bad_request[10] ^= 1
            native("updater", work / (model + "-staged"), put(model + "-bad-request", bad_request), image_path, 0)
            pass_check(model + ": exact OTA decode/flash-request scan and corrupt header/load/size/request negatives")
    receipt = {"status": "OFFLINE_COMPATIBILITY_ONLY", "firmware_git_tree": TREE,
               "upstream_commit": manifest["commit"], "package_sha256": {k:v[1] for k,v in PACKAGES.items()},
               "sanitize": args.sanitize,
               "leak_sanitizer": "NOT_RUN: ptrace executor incompatibility; detect_leaks=0" if args.sanitize else "NOT_RUN",
               "checks": CHECKS, "source_sha256": source_hashes,
               "limits": ["No firmware or bootloader installed or executed on a target.",
                          "No platform/GPIO/SPI/USB backend compiled or opened.",
                          "No test of physical boot, timing, ROM behavior or power interruption.",
                          "Synthetic boot transform is not a deployable image; it is deleted with all temporary bytes.",
                          "Known package config and adoption-gate gaps remain; no default generation or guard changes."]}
    if args.receipt:
        args.receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.receipt.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"status": receipt["status"], "checks": len(CHECKS), "sanitize": args.sanitize}))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# tools/fm1_install.py start guards for a real device (no device is opened: MidoBackend is replaced by a stub).
#   check 3 (rule 7): stdin is not a TTY and STY and TMUX are empty -> "REFUSED", exit 10. Cases: tests/host/fixtures/install_guards/foreground.txt.
#   check 14 (rule 3): the hardware lock file (X0X_HW_LOCK) is held by another process -> "REFUSED", exit 10, for an
#     install and for --info. A free lock -> the run continues (the stub backend then says "not found", exit 3).
#   The gate guard stays the first step: no --commit -> exit 9.
set -u
TOP="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/instguard.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
printf 'pkg\n' > "$T/p.fwsc"
X0X_HW_LOCK="$T/hw.lock" TOP="$TOP" T="$T" python3 - <<'PY'
import io, os, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.environ["TOP"], "tools"))
import fm1_install as m
T = os.environ["T"]; fails = n = 0
def ok(c, what):
    global fails, n
    n += 1
    print(("ok   " if c else "FAIL ") + what)
    if not c: fails += 1
class Stdin:
    def __init__(s, t): s.t = t
    def isatty(s): return s.t
fx = os.path.join(os.environ["TOP"], "tests/host/fixtures/install_guards/foreground.txt")
fg = getattr(m, "foreground_guard", None)
for line in open(fx):
    if line.startswith("#") or not line.strip(): continue
    name, tty, sty, tmux, want = line.rstrip("\n").split("|")
    env = {k: v for k, v in (("STY", sty), ("TMUX", tmux)) if v}
    rc = fg(Stdin(tty == "1"), env) if fg else None
    ok(rc == (0 if want == "OK" else 10), f"foreground guard, {name}: rc {rc}, want {want}")
# main(): gate guard first, then the foreground guard, then the lock
class NoDevice(Exception): pass
def stub(): raise m.InstallError("notfound", "stub backend: no device")
m.MidoBackend = stub
real_gg = m.gate_guard
ok(m.main([os.path.join(T, "p.fwsc")]) == 9, "main: no --commit -> gate guard exit 9 (first step)")
m.gate_guard = lambda a: 0
sys.stdin = Stdin(False); os.environ.pop("STY", None); os.environ.pop("TMUX", None)
ok(m.main([os.path.join(T, "p.fwsc"), "--commit", "abc1234"]) == 10, "main: no TTY, no screen -> exit 10")
os.environ["STY"] = "1.x0x"
ok(m.main([os.path.join(T, "p.fwsc"), "--commit", "abc1234"]) == 3, "main: screen session, free lock -> continues (stub: exit 3)")
def release():   # this process keeps the lock after a run (as a real run does): drop it for the next case
    if m._HW_LOCK: m._HW_LOCK.close(); m._HW_LOCK = None
release()
# a second process holds the lock (it waits at most 20 s for it)
holder = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import fcntl, os, sys, time; f = open(os.environ['X0X_HW_LOCK'], 'a'); "
                           "t = time.time()\nwhile True:\n try: fcntl.flock(f, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB); break\n except OSError:\n  if time.time() - t > 20: sys.exit(1)\n  time.sleep(0.1)\n"
                           "print('held', flush=True); time.sleep(30)"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
holder.stdout.readline()
ok(m.main([os.path.join(T, "p.fwsc"), "--commit", "abc1234"]) == 10, "main: lock held by another process -> install exit 10")
ok(m.main(["--info"]) == 10, "main: lock held by another process -> --info exit 10")
holder.kill(); holder.wait(); release()
ok(m.main(["--info"]) == 3, "main: lock free again -> --info continues (stub: exit 3)")
print(f"install guards: {n - fails} of {n} ok")
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PY

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0
# Copyright (C) 2026 M. Geisler (genkigenki/makkuro)
#
# Compile and link the Bluetooth controller image. Runs on Linux x86-64 with the JieLi pi32v2
# toolchain (the only host it exists for), normally inside a throwaway container that
# ble/ctl/build_ctl.sh starts:
#   TC   the toolchain root (has pi32v2/bin/clang)         default /tc
#   REPO the X0X checkout                                    default /w
#   OUT  where ctl.elf, ctl.map and the reports go           default $REPO/ble/ctl/out
#   X0X_JOBS  independent compile jobs (1 = serial)           default 4, maximum 64
set -eu
TC=${TC:-/tc}; REPO=${REPO:-/w}; OUT=${OUT:-$REPO/ble/ctl/out}
T=$TC/pi32v2/bin
mkdir -p "$OUT"
# An unsuccessful invocation must not leave a previous image looking successful.
rm -f "$OUT/ctl.elf" "$OUT/ctl.img" "$OUT/ctl.map" "$OUT/cc_warn.txt" "$OUT/ld.txt" "$OUT/undef.txt" "$OUT/sections.txt" "$OUT/symbols.txt"
command -v setsid >/dev/null || { echo "Controller compilation needs setsid" >&2; exit 1; }
JOBS=${X0X_JOBS-4}
case "$JOBS" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0|0*) echo "Invalid X0X_JOBS: $JOBS (use 1..64)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
[ "${#JOBS}" -le 2 ] && [ "$JOBS" -le 64 ] || { echo "Invalid X0X_JOBS: $JOBS (use 1..64)" >&2; exit 1; }
CF="-target pi32v2 -integrated-as -mcpu=r3 -mfprev1 -Oz -flto -fno-common -fallow-pointer-null \
    -fprefer-gnu-section -mllvm -pi32v2-large-program=true -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -fms-extensions -ffreestanding \
    -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Werror"
# Work in /tmp: a shared folder (Colima, Docker Desktop) can serve stale file sizes after an edit.
B=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ctlbuild.XXXXXX")
PIDS=""
stop_jobs() {
  # Each compiler has its own process group, including any driver children.
  # Also signal the direct PID in case interruption precedes setsid execution.
  for pid in $PIDS; do kill -TERM "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  for pid in $PIDS; do kill -KILL "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  for pid in $PIDS; do wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  PIDS=""
}
cleanup() { stop_jobs; rm -rf "$B"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
mkdir -p "$B/obj" "$OUT"
cp -r "$REPO/ble/ctl/src" "$REPO/ble/ctl/gen" "$REPO/ble/ctl/lib" "$REPO/ble/ctl/ctl.ld" "$B/"
cp "$REPO/firmware/hal/x0x_ble_abi.h" "$B/src/"
cd "$B"; OBJS=""; : > obj/cc_warn.txt
# Keep link order exactly as the serial source glob order.
# Batches bound the job count on POSIX sh, including older shells without wait -n.
: > obj/units
failed=0; count=0
join_jobs() {
  remaining=${PIDS# }
  for pid in $PIDS; do
    case "$remaining" in *" "*) remaining=${remaining#* } ;; *) remaining="" ;; esac
    if ! wait "$pid"; then
      failed=1
    fi
    # Even a successful driver can leave children. Stop its group before dropping
    # ownership, including at batch boundaries. Only unjoined drivers need waits.
    kill -KILL "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    PIDS="$remaining"
    if [ "$failed" != 0 ]; then stop_jobs; break; fi
  done
  PIDS=""; count=0
}
for f in src/*.c src/*.S gen/*.c; do
  o=obj/$(basename "$f").o
  case "$f" in gen/*) W="-Wno-error -w";; *) W="";; esac
  # Redirect both streams per unit; output is merged in source order after joining.
  setsid "$T/clang" $CF $W -Isrc -c "$f" -o "$o" > "$o.log" 2>&1 &
  PIDS="$PIDS $!"; count=$((count + 1))
  printf '%s\n' "$o" >> obj/units
  OBJS="$OBJS $o"
  if [ "$count" -ge "$JOBS" ]; then join_jobs; [ "$failed" = 0 ] || break; fi
done
[ -z "$PIDS" ] || join_jobs
while IFS= read -r o; do cat "$o.log" >> obj/cc_warn.txt; done < obj/units
cp obj/cc_warn.txt "$OUT/"
if [ "$failed" != 0 ]; then echo "CC FAIL (see $OUT/cc_warn.txt)"; cat obj/cc_warn.txt; exit 1; fi

L=$B/lib
set +e
$T/ld --plugin $T/LLVMgold.so --plugin-opt=mcpu=r3 --plugin-opt=-mattr=+fprev1 \
  --plugin-opt=-inline-threshold=0 --plugin-opt=-global-merge-on-const --plugin-opt=-enable-ipra=true --plugin-opt=-pi32v2-large-program=true \
  \
  --gc-sections -T ctl.ld -Map obj/ctl.map -o obj/ctl.elf $OBJS \
  --start-group $L/btctrler.a $L/wl_rf_common.a $L/crypto_toolbox_Osize.a $L/lib_ccm_aes.a $L/libc.a $L/libcompiler_rt.a --end-group \
  > obj/ld.txt 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
grep -o "undefined reference to \`[^']*'" obj/ld.txt | sed "s/.*\`//;s/'//" | sort -u > obj/undef.txt || true
echo "ld exit $RC, undefined symbols: $(wc -l < obj/undef.txt)"
grep -v -E 'undefined reference|In function' obj/ld.txt | head -20 || true
cp obj/cc_warn.txt obj/ld.txt obj/undef.txt obj/ctl.map "$OUT/"
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || exit 1
$T/objdump -h obj/ctl.elf > "$OUT/sections.txt"
$T/objdump -t obj/ctl.elf > "$OUT/symbols.txt"
cp obj/ctl.elf obj/ctl.map "$OUT/"
if [ -s obj/cc_warn.txt ]; then echo "compiler warnings:"; cat obj/cc_warn.txt; fi

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Miami mod wheel → W_WOBBLE_DEPTH on product WBL1 path.
set -eu
TEST_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
SRC=${X0X_SOURCE_ROOT:-$TEST_ROOT}
OUT=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
awk '/^static void smk_wheels\(void\)/{on=1} on{print} on && /^}/{exit}' "$SRC/firmware/src/app/main_fm1.c" > "$OUT/smk_wheels.inc"
test -s "$OUT/smk_wheels.inc"

/* IRQ entry wrappers: save what a C call may clobber, call the C body,
 * restore, csync, rti. clang does not emit the csync needed before rti,
 * so ISRs are not written in C directly. */
	.macro FM1_ISR name, body
	.section .text.\name,"ax",@progbits
	.globl \name
\name:
	[--sp] = {psr, rets, reti}
	[--sp] = {r3-r0}
	call \body
	{r3-r0} = [sp++]
	{psr, rets, reti} = [sp++]
	csync
	rti
	.endm

/* timer 5: as FM1_ISR, and its sp after the pushes goes to fm1_t5_sp (fm1_guard.h, the frame watch) */
	.section .text.isr_timer5,"ax",@progbits
	.globl isr_timer5
isr_timer5:
	[--sp] = {psr, rets, reti}
	[--sp] = {r3-r0}
	r0 = fm1_t5_sp
	r1 = sp
	[r0 + 0] = r1
	call fm1_timer5_irq
	{r3-r0} = [sp++]
	{psr, rets, reti} = [sp++]
	csync
	rti

	FM1_ISR isr_alnk0, fm1_alnk0_irq

"""Bluetooth start test of an SMK-37 over USB, with no hands on the unit.

Each round:
  1. ED_BT_TEST op 1: clear the start block (as BLUETOOTH OFF). The BLUETOOTH setting must be ON.
  2. ED_BT_TEST op 2: the unit restarts (a chip reset through P33, as fm1_reboot). It never goes
     to the update loader.
  3. Wait until the USB MIDI port goes and comes back. After a crash the unit shows the crash
     screen for 4 s and restarts once more: wait until DIAG answers and the state is stable.
  4. Read DIAG (editor command 33) and print STATUS, the start record and the crash record.
     --diag-only also prints the inbound recorder and the pad LED output (editor command 38 INLOG).
     --padcal-export FILE reads the pad calibration (CLP-79, INLOG args 2-5) for apc_pad_colors.py --pad-override.
     --pad-inputs reads one sensor snapshot (INLOG arg 6), without any Bluetooth reset/test commands.
     For READY, read DIAG again after --hold seconds: the controller must stay up (polls grow).

A software restart is not a power cycle: .noinit RAM (the start guard, the crash record) stays,
and the radio's analog and power (P33) state may stay too. Confirm a result with a real power
cycle at the end.

Usage: tools/ble_autotest.py [-n ROUNDS] [--hold S] [--log FILE] [--diag-only]
Needs mido with python-rtmidi. Exit 0 = every round READY and stayed up.
"""
import argparse
import json
import sys
import time

import mido

sys.path.insert(0, str(__import__('pathlib').Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import inlog_fmt  # noqa: E402  (a76: editor command 38 INLOG)

HDR = [0x7D, 0x46, 0x4C]
ED_DIAG, ED_BT_TEST = 33, 34
PORT_KEYS = ("X0X", "SMK", "FM-1", "Felucca")

CRASH = ["magic", "count", "vec", "pc", "rets", "emu", "dbg", "sp", "psr", "icfg", "up_ms",
         "etm0", "etm1", "etm2", "etm3", "early", "core"]
BOOT = ["bg_failed", "bg_pending"]
GUARD = ["g_magic", "trying", "blocked", "why", "fails", "start_ms", "init_ms", "mb_state", "mb_err",
         "dbg_stage", "dbg_ms", "dbg_delays", "dbg_ra", "dbg_init_ms", "dbg_stall", "reset_prev",
         "sink_n", "sink_at", "sink_val", "wait_end", "xosc_pre", "xosc_post", "wait_ms",
         "seen_stage", "seen_ms", "seen_delays", "seen_ra", "code_bad", "code_sum"]
LIVE = ["img_boot_up_dead", "want_host_blocked_c1on", "c1_gave_up", "plat_state", "mb_state_now",
        "mb_err_now", "polls", "poll_max", "h_state", "c1_trace", "reset_now",
        "h2c", "c2h", "c2h_drops", "h_step", "ctl_took", "ctl_gave", "rx0", "rx1", "alive_ms", "alive_polls", "rails0", "rails1"]
STATE = ["NO IMAGE", "OFF", "RESTART TO TURN ON", "STARTING", "READY", "CONNECTED", "FAILED", "BAD IMAGE"]
WHY = ["-", "TIMEOUT", "WRONG JOB", "NOT READY", "RESET", "NO TICK"]
MB = ["OFF", "INIT", "READY", "FAILED"]
ERR = ["NONE", "BOOT", "HEAP", "TASK", "ASSERT", "RESET"]


def ports():
    i = [n for n in mido.get_input_names() if any(k in n for k in PORT_KEYS)]
    o = [n for n in mido.get_output_names() if any(k in n for k in PORT_KEYS)]
    return (i[0], o[0]) if i and o else None


def ask(cmd, args=(), timeout=3.0, tries=2):
    """one request; again once if no reply (after idle the first reply can be lost: the host
    does not read the USB IN endpoint at once, and the unit gives a SysEx reply 200 ms)"""
    for _ in range(tries):
        r = _ask(cmd, args, timeout)
        if r is not None:
            return r
    return None


def _ask(cmd, args=(), timeout=3.0):
    p = ports()
    if not p:
        return None
    with mido.open_input(p[0]) as i, mido.open_output(p[1]) as o:
        time.sleep(0.3)                            # macOS drops a message sent at once after the port opens
        for _ in i.iter_pending():
            pass
        o.send(mido.Message("sysex", data=HDR + [cmd] + list(args)))
        t = time.time()
        while time.time() - t < timeout:
            for m in i.iter_pending():
                if m.type == "sysex" and list(m.data[:4]) == HDR + [cmd]:
                    return list(m.data[4:])
            time.sleep(0.01)
    return None


def diag():
    r = ask(ED_DIAG)
    if not r:
        return None
    n, w = r[0], []
    for k in range(n):
        b = r[1 + 5 * k:6 + 5 * k]
        w.append(b[0] | b[1] << 7 | b[2] << 14 | b[3] << 21 | (b[4] & 15) << 28)
    trace = {}
    if len(w) >= 6 and w[-6] == 0x534D4301:
        trace = dict(zip(["smc_trace", "smc_handles", "smc_acl0", "smc_acl1", "smc_reject", "smc_att"], w[-6:]))
        w = w[:-6]
    head = CRASH + BOOT
    d = {k: v for k, v in zip(head, w)}
    rest = w[len(head):]
    if len(rest) >= len(LIVE):                     # the live words are always the last len(LIVE)
        d.update(zip(LIVE, rest[-len(LIVE):]))
        rest = rest[:-len(LIVE)]
    d.update(trace)
    d.update(zip(GUARD, rest))                     # an older firmware sends fewer guard words
    for k in GUARD + LIVE:
        d.setdefault(k, 0)
    return d


def wait_port(present, timeout):
    t = time.time()
    while time.time() - t < timeout:
        if bool(ports()) == present:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.2)
    return False


def settle(timeout=30.0):
    """DIAG after the restart(s): wait until the state is not STARTING and the port stays."""
    t, last, any_d = time.time(), None, None
    while time.time() - t < timeout:
        if not ports():
            time.sleep(0.3)
            continue
        d = diag()
        any_d = d or any_d
        if d and STATE[d.get("plat_state", 0) % 8] != "STARTING":
            if last and last.get("reset_now") == d.get("reset_now") and time.time() - t > 6:
                return d
            last = d
        time.sleep(1.0)
    return last or any_d                           # still STARTING after the timeout: that state


T5W = ["magic", "ms", "ticks", "tag", "dbg", "c0n", "c1n", "prpn", "prpid", "hits", "h_ms", "h_tag", "h_slot",
       "h_old", "h_new", "h_sp", "h_dbg", "h_prpid", "h_c1n", "h_prpn", "icfg0_3", "icfg0_5", "hits_now"]
C1R = ["d_magic", "d_n", "d_t4_ms", "d_c0_ms", "d_dbg", "d_emu"] + [f"d_etm{i}_{j}" for i in range(4) for j in range(4)] + ["c_armed", "c_n", "c_scans"] + [f"c_{i}_{f}" for i in range(8) for f in ("at", "val", "ms")]
TAG = ["begin", "after input", "before Bluetooth", "after Bluetooth", "end"]
SLOT = ["r3", "r2", "r1", "r0", "psr", "rets", "reti", "word above"]


def bt_words(op):
    r = ask(ED_BT_TEST, [op])
    if not r or r[0] != op:
        return None
    w = []
    for k in range(r[1]):
        b = r[2 + 5 * k:7 + 5 * k]
        if len(b) < 5:
            break
        w.append(b[0] | b[1] << 7 | b[2] << 14 | b[3] << 21 | (b[4] & 15) << 28)
    return w


def t5w():
    """ED_BT_TEST op 3: the timer 5 frame watch of the last boot (fm1_guard.h); op 4: core 1's records"""
    w = bt_words(3)
    if w is None:
        return None
    t = dict(zip(T5W, w))
    w4 = bt_words(4)
    if w4:
        t.update(zip(C1R, w4))
    return t


def t5w_text(t):
    if not t:
        return "no reply (older firmware)"
    if t["magic"] != 0x54355731:
        return f"no record of the last boot; changes now {t['hits_now']}"
    s = (f"last boot: last tick at {t['ms']} ms (tick {t['ticks']}, checkpoint {TAG[t['tag'] % 5]}); "
         f"DBG_MSG 0x{t['dbg']:08X}, write limit errors core0 {t['c0n']} core1 {t['c1n']} DMA {t['prpn']} "
         f"(DMA id 0x{t['prpid']:X}); frame changes {t['hits']}")
    if t["hits"]:
        s += (f"; first at {t['h_ms']} ms, found at {TAG[t['h_tag'] % 5]}, word {SLOT[t['h_slot'] % 8]} "
              f"at 0x{t['h_sp'] + 4 * t['h_slot']:08X}: 0x{t['h_old']:08X} -> 0x{t['h_new']:08X}, "
              f"DBG_MSG 0x{t['h_dbg']:08X}, core1 errors {t['h_c1n']}, DMA errors {t['h_prpn']} id 0x{t['h_prpid']:X}")
    if "icfg0_3" in t:
        s += f"; core 0 ICFG 24-31 0x{t['icfg0_3']:08X} 40-47 0x{t['icfg0_5']:08X}"
    s += f"; changes this boot {t.get('hits_now', 0)}"
    if t.get("d_magic") == 0xC0DEAD01:
        s += (f"\n          core 1 saw core 0 stop: clock stuck at {t['d_c0_ms']} ms (TIMER4 {t['d_t4_ms']} ms), "
              f"DBG_MSG 0x{t['d_dbg']:08X} EMU_MSG 0x{t['d_emu']:08X}; core 0 ETM:")
        for i in range(min(t["d_n"], 4)):
            s += " [" + " ".join(f"{t[f'd_etm{i}_{j}']:08X}" for j in range(4)) + "]"
    elif "d_magic" in t:
        s += "; core 1 did not see core 0 stop"
    if t.get("c_armed") == 0xCA9A11E5:
        s += f"\n          RAM canary 0x01C72000-0x01C74000: {t['c_n']} changed words in {t['c_scans']} full scans"
        for i in range(min(t["c_n"], 8)):
            s += f"; 0x{t[f'c_{i}_at']:08X}=0x{t[f'c_{i}_val']:08X} at {t[f'c_{i}_ms']} ms"
    return s


def h(v):
    return f"0x{v:08X}"


def summary(d, before):
    s = STATE[d["plat_state"] % 8] if "plat_state" in d else "?"
    crash_new = before is None or any(d.get(k) != before.get(k) for k in ("count", "pc", "up_ms", "rets"))
    out = {
        "status": s,
        "guard": f"blocked {d['blocked']} why {WHY[d['why'] % 6]} fails {d['fails']}",
        "start": f"mailbox {MB[d['mb_state'] % 4]} err {ERR[d['mb_err'] % 6]} stage {d['dbg_stage']} "
                 f"delays {d['dbg_delays']} stage time {d['dbg_ms']} ms image init {d['dbg_init_ms']} ms "
                 f"core0 wait {h(d['wait_end'])} last look {d['wait_ms']} ms",
        "xosc": f"{h(d['xosc_pre'])} -> {h(d['xosc_post'])}",
        "core0": f"last look {d['wait_ms']} ms; image then: stage {d['seen_stage']} at {d['seen_ms']} ms, "
                 f"delays {d['seen_delays']}, last delay caller {h(d['seen_ra'])}; RAM code "
                 + (f"CHANGED at {d['code_bad'] & 0xFFFFF} ms (sum {h(d['code_sum'])})" if d['code_bad'] else "unchanged"),
        "hci": f"host state {d['h_state']} step {d['h_step'] & 0xFF} wait {d['h_step'] >> 8 & 0xFF} "
               f"credits {d['h_step'] >> 16 & 0xFF}; h2c head/tail {d['h2c'] & 0xFFFF}/{d['h2c'] >> 16} "
               f"c2h {d['c2h'] & 0xFFFF}/{d['c2h'] >> 16} drops {d['c2h_drops']}; controller took "
               f"{d['ctl_took']}, gave {d['ctl_gave']}; polls {d['polls']}",
        "link": (f"SMC receive (counters modulo 256): ACL {d['rx0'] & 255}, notifications {d['rx0'] >> 8 & 255}, "
                 f"MIDI {d['rx0'] >> 16 & 255}, rejected {d['rx0'] >> 24}; last receive rejection "
                 f"{d['h_step'] >> 24 & 127}; queue enqueued {d['rx1'] & 255}, dropped {d['rx1'] >> 8 & 255}, "
                 f"dispatched {d['rx1'] >> 16 & 255}, dispatch reason {d['rx1'] >> 24}"
                 if d['h_step'] & 0x80000000 else f"interval {(d['rx0'] & 0xFFFF) * 1.25:g} ms, latency {d['rx1'] >> 21 & 7}; last end reason 0x{d['rx0'] >> 16 & 0xFF:02X}; "
                 f"pairing refused {d['rx0'] >> 24}; asked MTU {d['rx1'] >> 8 & 0x3FF}; L2CAP requests {d['rx1'] >> 24}; MIDI in drops {d['rx1'] & 0xFF}; "
                 f"parameter request {['not sent', 'sent'][d['rx1'] >> 18 & 1]}, {['no answer', 'accepted', 'rejected', '?'][d['rx1'] >> 19 & 3]}"),
        "alive": f"core 0 last Bluetooth tick at {d['alive_ms']} ms after boot, core 1 polls then {d['alive_polls']}, now {d['polls']}",
        "rails": (lambda a, b: f"before/after the stock supply setup: SYSVDD sel {(a >> 16) & 15} -> {(b >> 16) & 15}, VDC14 sel {(a >> 8) & 7} -> {(b >> 8) & 7}, VDDIOM sel {a & 7} -> {b & 7}, CON0 0x{(a >> 24) & 255:02X} -> 0x{(b >> 24) & 255:02X} (DCDC13 {'on' if (b >> 24) & 8 else 'off'}, LDO13 {'on' if (b >> 24) & 4 else 'off'}); setup read-back {'ok' if ((b >> 24) & 0x0C) == 0x08 and (b & 0x37) == 0x34 and ((b >> 8) & 7) == 7 and ((b >> 16) & 15) == 15 else 'NOT ok'} (raw 0x{a:08X} -> 0x{b:08X})")(d.get('rails0', 0), d.get('rails1', 0)),
        "reset": f"this boot {h(d['reset_now'])} last start {h(d['reset_prev'])}",
        "crash": (f"NEW core {d['core']} vec {d['vec']} PC {h(d['pc'])} RETS {h(d['rets'])} DBG {h(d['dbg'])} "
                  f"up {d['up_ms']} ms etm {h(d['etm3'])} {h(d['etm2'])} {h(d['etm1'])} {h(d['etm0'])}")
                 if crash_new and d.get("magic") == 0x43525348 else "none new",
    }
    if d.get("smc_trace") == 0x534D4301 and d["h_step"] & 0x80000000:
        hdr = d["smc_acl0"].to_bytes(4, "little") + d["smc_acl1"].to_bytes(4, "little")
        out["smc_trace"] = (f"value handle {d['smc_handles'] & 65535}, CCCD handle {d['smc_handles'] >> 16}; "
                            f"ATT response pending {d['smc_att'] >> 16}; "
                            f"last ATT opcode 0x{d['smc_reject'] >> 24:02X}, notify handle {d['smc_att'] & 65535}; "
                            f"last rejected ACL: reason {d['smc_reject'] >> 16 & 255}, bytes {d['smc_reject'] & 65535}, "
                            f"header {hdr.hex(' ')}, CID 0x{d['smc_acl1'] >> 16:04X} (CID valid for start packets of at least 8 bytes)")
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("-n", type=int, default=1, help="rounds (default 1)")
    ap.add_argument("--hold", type=float, default=20.0, help="seconds READY must stay up (default 20)")
    ap.add_argument("--log", help="append each round as one JSON line")
    ap.add_argument("--diag-only", action="store_true", help="read and print DIAG only")
    ap.add_argument("--pad-inputs", action="store_true", help="read one pad sensor snapshot only; never reset")
    ap.add_argument("--padcal-export", metavar="FILE",
                    help="read the pad calibration (CLP-79, INLOG args 2-5) into FILE for apc_pad_colors.py --pad-override")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if not ports():
        sys.exit("ble_autotest: no X0X USB MIDI port")
    if a.pad_inputs:
        d = inlog_fmt.parse_pad_inputs(ask(inlog_fmt.ED_INLOG, [inlog_fmt.PAD_INPUT_ARG]))
        print("\n".join(inlog_fmt.pad_inputs_text(d)))
        if d and d["status"] == "snapshot":
            print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))
            return 0
        return 1
    if a.padcal_export:
        ents, tl = [], None
        for arg in inlog_fmt.PADCAL_ARGS:
            rr = ask(inlog_fmt.ED_INLOG, [arg])
            e = inlog_fmt.parse_padcal(rr, arg)
            tl = inlog_fmt.parse_padcal_tl(rr)
            if e is None:
                sys.exit(f"ble_autotest: no pad calibration reply (arg {arg}; firmware before CLP-79?)")
            ents += e
        open(a.padcal_export, "w").write("\n".join(inlog_fmt.padcal_lines(ents, tl)) + "\n")
        print(f"{a.padcal_export}: {sum(e[4] for e in ents)} of 128 entries marked ok")
        return 0
    if a.diag_only:
        d = diag()
        if not d:
            sys.exit("ble_autotest: no DIAG reply")
        out = summary(d, d)
        out["t5w"] = t5w_text(t5w())
        print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
        p = inlog_fmt.parse(ask(inlog_fmt.ED_INLOG))      # a76: the inbound recorder and the pad output
        pal = inlog_fmt.palette()
        print("\n".join(inlog_fmt.text(p, pal)))
        print("\n".join(inlog_fmt.pads_text(inlog_fmt.parse_pads(ask(inlog_fmt.ED_INLOG, [1])), p[2] if p else None)))
        return 0
    ok = 0
    for rnd in range(1, a.n + 1):
        before = diag()
        r = ask(ED_BT_TEST, [1])
        if not r:
            sys.exit("ble_autotest: no ED_BT_TEST reply (firmware without command 34?)")
        if not r[1]:
            sys.exit("ble_autotest: BLUETOOTH is OFF in the settings: set it ON once on the unit")
        ask(ED_BT_TEST, [2], timeout=1.0)
        t0 = time.time()
        if not wait_port(False, 10):
            print(f"round {rnd}: the port did not go away (no restart?)")
        if not wait_port(True, 40):
            sys.exit(f"round {rnd}: the unit did not come back on USB in 40 s: check it")
        d = settle()
        if not d:
            sys.exit(f"round {rnd}: no DIAG after the restart")
        s = summary(d, before)
        up = False
        if s["status"] in ("READY", "CONNECTED"):
            p0 = d["polls"]
            time.sleep(a.hold)
            d2 = diag()
            up = bool(d2) and STATE[d2["plat_state"] % 8] in ("READY", "CONNECTED") and d2["polls"] > p0 \
                and d2["alive_ms"] >= d["alive_ms"] + 900 * a.hold      # no reset: core 0 ticked all along
            s["hold"] = f"{a.hold:.0f} s: {'stayed up' if up else 'NOT up'}" + \
                (f", polls {p0} -> {d2['polls']}" if d2 else ", no DIAG")
        ok += up
        t = t5w()
        s["t5w"] = t5w_text(t)
        s["round"], s["seconds"] = rnd, round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        print(f"--- round {rnd} ({s['seconds']} s)")
        for k in ("status", "hold", "guard", "start", "hci", "alive", "rails", "reset", "crash", "t5w"):
            if k in s:
                print(f"  {k:7} {s[k]}")
        if a.log:
            with open(a.log, "a") as f:
                f.write(json.dumps({**s, "diag": d, "t5w_raw": t}) + "\n")
    print(f"=== {ok} of {a.n} rounds READY and stayed up")
    return 0 if ok == a.n else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
